summary: Expedited offboarding after security flag: partial device recovery + SCIM sync gap
description:
Issue summary:
Security team flagged former contractor (c-id: CTR-942) for potential data exfiltration indicators after exit. HR initiated standard offboarding on 2026-03-08 but SCIM provisioning job experienced a delay and several service tokens remained active.

Impact:
- Potential active API tokens and cloud console sessions for the departed contractor.
- Corporate laptop (asset tag LTP-1187) not yet returned; last MDM check-in 2026-03-09 03:12 UTC.
- One service account (svc-experiment-2025) still listed as a delegated principal in multiple projects.

Environment / Affected systems:
- Identity: Okta/SCIM -> internal user directory
- Device management: Intune/MDM (us-east region)
- Cloud IAM: GCP project redwood-research-us-east

Steps already taken:
1) HR marked account as terminated in BambooHR on 2026-03-08 (done).
2) Support ran immediate session revoke for Okta SSO (partial) 2026-03-10 09:00 UTC (done).
3) Investigated SCIM logs: provisioning job failed to remove user on 2026-03-09 02:45 UTC due to schema mismatch error.
4) Security rotated org-level service keys for a subset of high-risk buckets (temporary mitigation).

Proposed immediate actions:
- Full token sweep across API keys and long-lived service tokens (priority).
- Manual removal of the offending user from IAM bindings in redwood-research-us-east (with SRE assistance).
- Trigger remote wipe via MDM and arrange courier pick-up for asset LTP-1187.
- Patch SCIM provisioning job to handle legacy schema variant; plan rollback after confirmation.

Questions for HR/Legal/InfoSec:
- Does Legal want a forensic image of the returned device if recovered?
- Approve escalation to revoke shared keys that may impact scheduled experiments?

2026-03-11 08:45 - HR (Lucas Rivera): Confirmed contractor final payment completed. HR requests a record of what was revoked for audit; will add to employee file.
2026-03-11 12:00 - Diego Marquez: Remote wipe command issued to MDM; awaiting confirmation of wipe status. Courier scheduled for 2026-03-12 09:00–12:00 local time.
investigation_notes: SCIM job log (2026-03-09 02:45): 'User deletion failed: attribute 'customDepartment' not found in target schema' — indicates legacy attribute caused deletion to abort.
Okta sessions: one active refresh token last used 2026-03-09 22:07 UTC from IP 34.199.120.45 (us-east).
MDM check-in metadata: LTP-1187 reported OS version macOS 13.5, last user 'ctr_user' login timestamp 2026-03-09 03:05 UTC.
GCP IAM bindings query: svc-experiment-2025 has owner-level binding on project redwood-research-us-east (likely accidental).
resolution: Work in progress. Immediate mitigations completed: revoked active Okta refresh token, rotated selected org keys, blocked svc-experiment-2025 scope pending review. Scheduled the following: 1) MDM remote wipe and courier pick-up on 2026-03-12, 2) Manual removal of user from GCP IAM after snapshot and backup of bindings, 3) SCIM job fix PR opened (see related PR). Final resolution will include confirmation of device receipt and a forensic imaging decision from Legal.
next_steps: Diego to complete IAM cleanup after SRE backup window (ETA 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC).
SRE to run a one-off binding snapshot and then remove user principals referenced in bindings (ETA 2026-03-12).
Security/Legal to confirm whether forensic imaging is required upon device return (pending).
Engops to merge SCIM schema fallback PR and deploy to staging for verification (related PR above).
HR to attach the offboarding audit record and closure note once all revocations and device recovery are confirmed.
